recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Future IG Publisher binary distribution issues should be handled in the current IG Publisher release/download infrastructure, not by restoring the obsolete core downloads-page JAR link.
issue_request: FHIR-12354 reported that the September 2016 org.hl7.fhir.igpublisher.jar linked from the FHIR-core downloads page was corrupt and could not be opened by Java jar tooling or 7zip. The issue is Published/Persuasive, and the recorded resolution says the problem was already fixed because the version on build.fhir.org worked.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-12354 source commit was found. Git history shows the downloads page previously had a direct org.hl7.fhir.igpublisher.jar link, later changed the IG Publisher download URL, and then removed direct IG Publisher/validator tool links when tooling was split out from the core downloads page.
additional_context: source/downloads.html remains a current published page through publish.ini. Its current Implementation Tools section points to the HL7 tools registry and FHIR NPM packages used by tools such as the IG publisher and validator, not to an IG Publisher JAR. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-12354-specific community record; later jar-phrase Zulip hits concerned 2019 publisher download troubleshooting and did not conflict with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current FHIR core source already avoids the corrupt historical direct JAR download and has no active org.hl7.fhir.igpublisher.jar link to repair.
